title: 情報セキュリティ
subtitle: Information Security
educationalGoal: In this course, you can learn cryptography and network security. The first half of the course deals with elliptic curve cryptography which is gradually spreading in practice. The second half of the course deal with adaptation of security technique such as encryption and authentication to the Internet.
advice: In the first half of the course, the textbook "誤り訂正符号と暗号の基礎数理" is used and you can learn cryptography especially ellipctic curve cryptography. In the second half of the course, the textbook "マスタリングTCP/IP 情報セキュリティ編" is used. The students learn adaptation of security technique such as encryption and authentication to the Internet environment. The students also learn general network security. Understanding TCP/IP is important.
books: 笠原正雄,佐竹賢治著:誤り訂正符号と暗号の基礎数理,コロナ社,2004 齋藤孝道著:マスタリングTCP/IP 情報セキュリティ編,オーム社,2013
requiredKnowledge: Taking "Algebra for Computer Science" helps to learn this course especially for the first half of the course. Knowledge about TCP/IP is required.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the public-key cryptography
Be able to explain the details of the discrete logarithm problem
Be able to explain the encoding and decoding in elliptic curve cryptography
Be able to explain authentication technique
Be able to explain network security technique
Be able to explain security technique for the hosts in networks
